evidence.mechanism: shot-02s: 48 upright rust-and-graphite strips in an 8x6 grid, only the bottom row tilting; by shot-08s the arcs curl upward with tips visibly trailing bases, and by shot-20s the top rows still curl while the bottom reopens.
evidence.ambition: shot-08s: 48 nested segment chains render as flat DOM divs with two faces, one rendering idea and no shading, lighting or material beyond rust versus graphite; by shot-20s the pull-back to a cream margin is the only added layer.
evidence.craft: shot-08s: clean flat fills and crisp segment seams, but the fiber lines are near-invisible hairlines and the strips are small on a large empty cream field; by shot-20s the diagonal gradient is tidy without texture.
evidence.distinctness: shot-08s: cream ground with a rust and graphite palette and a grid of bent strips; the look sits close to cream-editorial pieces, and each strip bends by one smooth rotation with no distinct layer or composition.
evidence.polish: shot-02s: composed full-frame grid with the bottom row already tilting; by shot-20s the camera has pulled back to a cream margin and the top row is still curled, so the piece resolves into a diagonal gradient that differs from 2s.

pairwise_justification: No median archive yet; no head-to-head comparison is possible.

critique.change: Draw visible fiber bundles and a porous brown-tissue shade across each strip so the skin-over-fiber layering reads at shot-02s and shot-08s, not just as rust and graphite halves.
Widen the per-segment animation-delay spread so the top segments visibly lag the base at shot-08s, instead of every strip showing the same uniform arc.
Enlarge the strips so the 2 s grid fills more of the frame, cutting the empty cream field that makes the craft look thin at full size.
